# MM-P2-L3-HT02 - Maintenance manual - Machining heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L3-HT02

Scope
This document defines preventive maintenance and verification tasks for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02). Activities cover control setpoint verification, thermocouple calibration, visual inspection, and basic corrective actions required to maintain process stability and product conformity. Refer to SB-1023, SB-1045, and SOP-P2-L3-03 for related procedures and safety requirements.

Tools
- Hand tools suitable for panel access and terminal checks
- Insulated thermocouple connector kit
- Calibration reference thermometer and traceable calibration certificate
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L3-03

Procedure
- Prepare the furnace for maintenance in accordance with SOP-P2-L3-03 and lockout/tagout requirements cited in SB-1023.
- Verify the control austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) at the control interface. The austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 845 °C. Confirm displayed value matches documented setpoint.
- Perform thermocouple integrity check and functional test against the calibration reference thermometer. The thermocouple calibration interval for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) is 50 days; record the calibration event and next due date in the equipment maintenance record.
- Inspect furnace interior, door seals, insulation condition, and control wiring for signs of degradation. Report findings per SB-1045.
- Restore furnace to service following verification steps and document any deviations and corrective actions in the maintenance log.

Acceptance criteria
- Control interface shows the austenitizing setpoint for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) as 845 °C.
- Thermocouple calibration completed and recorded consistent with the thermocouple calibration interval for Machining heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L3-HT02) of 50 days.
- No unresolved safety or functional discrepancies recorded; any corrective actions closed and documented per SB-1023 and SB-1045.
